pages.text: An organism does what its grafts tell it to. Place a graft on its flesh.$(br2)A $(l)Tap$() lets the stored essence out: fill a vial from it, or set a jug in front of it and it fills the jug by itself.
A $(l)Leech Tendril$() drains the organism's essence from every creature within four blocks. A pen of leashed cows around a Density organism is, I admit, a strange sight. It is also a farm.
pages.title: Leech Tendril
